book: The test runs its first report after the transfers of :63-64 and adds the third, Bank to Another Bank $25 on 1979-03-15, at :81 before the other two. This book has all three. The first run's figures hold on it: the report sums the selected accounts' daily balances (5.17:gnucash/report/reports/example/average-balance.scm:362-373), which the internal transfer leaves unchanged, and March's profit is the sum of its +$25 and -$25 split amounts, $0.00 as with no splits (:172, :189).
optionValues: Options are those changed from the template's defaults (Step Size MonthDelta, so one row per month, January to June 1979). {"absolute": day} is gnc-dmy2time64 of that day, local (here UTC) midnight.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109): table 1, every row (null), column N counted from 1. The rendered HTML has its <script> elements stripped first (:31-33). Columns (average-balance.scm:136-138): 1 Period start, 2 Period end, 3 Average, 4 Maximum, 5 Minimum, 6 Gain, 7 Loss, 8 Profit.
